## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes with zero issues
- [ ] `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .` passes
- [ ] `flutter test` passes locally
- [ ] Relevant `docs/features/*.feature` file added/updated, if behavior changed
- [ ] If this changes a database table: migration added, `schema_version` bumped, export/import updated for the new shape
- [ ] No network calls, analytics/telemetry, or cloud SDKs introduced (app is offline-only)
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording attached, for UI changes
